title: Score export, schema 1: manifest of a .npz written by ml-service/qc/score_export.py
description: The .npz holds this manifest as a JSON string plus arrays: periods (P ISO dates), lat and lon (n cells), scores (P x n float32, higher is more suspicious, NaN where not valid) and optional fault_<kind> arrays of the same shape. Scores of the trained models are validated on SYNTHETIC faults only. The station-to-cell mapping is not part of the file.

calibrated.description: true only when a threshold was fixed under a clean-period false-alarm budget

test_years_included.description: true only for the single test pass

sha256.description: added to the returned manifest after writing; not stored inside the file
